available_at: IEM: observation time + 5 minutes is an availability proxy; match only by prediction_time and retain observations no older than 120 minutes. Receipt time is not verified. Historical receipt time is not verified.
missing_handling: Keep source NA; model uses training-only median plus missing indicator. NOAA fills this value only when NA and unambiguous, with an eligible as-of observation.
